description: admin.rs check_bearer_token uses subtle::ConstantTimeEq but ct_eq on slices of different lengths returns 0 in constant time *within the comparison* — however the byte slice lengths are visible to the attacker via other channels and the implementation reveals the expected token length: if header.len() != expected.len() the comparison short-circuits at the slice level before entering ct_eq. An attacker sending tokens of different lengths can binary-search the token length by observing whether ct_eq is even entered. Should use constant_time_eq from the subtle crate with explicit length-equalization (e.g. pad both to a fixed size or use hmac-based comparison).
title: check_bearer_token length leak: ct_eq leaks token length
